topic: Stroke deaths by country: China ~2.6 million stroke deaths in 2021 (GBD 2021), about one third of the 7.3 million worldwide; USA 165,393 (2022, CDC/AHA); World Stroke Day 29 October; FAST signs
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: The United States, with its famous heart-disease problem, has the most stroke deaths.
myths.reality: The US recorded 165,393 stroke deaths in 2022; China recorded about 2.6 million in 2021 — roughly sixteen times more, from about four times the population.
